editorial.meta_description: Prepare for the Microsoft Dynamics 365 customer experience certification exam. Master core sales features, AI-driven sales, lead qualification, and opportunity.
editorial.overview: This thorough preparation guide is designed to help professionals successfully master the Microsoft Dynamics 365 customer experience certification exam by providing structured learning paths. The examination evaluates your ability to configure core sales features, deploy intelligent sales agents, qualify and prioritize leads, and manage deals using advanced opportunity research across the entire platform ecosystem.
editorial.who_should_take: This exam targets professionals who design and configure AI-enhanced sales solutions using Dynamics 365 Sales, Copilot, and agent capabilities. Candidates should have practical experience translating business requirements into seller workflows.
skills_summary: Qualify and prioritize leads using AI
Develop deals with intelligent opportunity research
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review the official study guide, documentation resources, and technical guides for Dynamics 365 Sales, Copilot, and artificial intelligence capabilities. Gain hands-on configuration experience working directly with the Microsoft Power Platform, model-driven applications, and automated cloud workflows to ensure complete readiness before taking the exam on test day.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Thoroughly review your scoring requirements, verify your testing setup, and ensure that your official candidate certification profile is securely connected to Microsoft Learn before your examination session officially begins today.

faq.question_title: What is the passing score for the exam?
faq.answer_text: A passing score of 700 or greater is required to successfully pass the examination, which is measured across a standardized scale ranging from 1 to 1000.

faq.question_title: Who certifies this customer experience exam?
faq.answer_text: Microsoft officially certifies this examination for candidates who design and configure advanced artificial intelligence enhanced sales solutions using Dynamics 365 Sales and related platform tools.

faq.question_title: How much does the certification exam cost?
faq.answer_text: The price is determined based on the specific country or region in which the examination is proctored, as Microsoft does not publish a standard United States dollar list price.

faq.question_title: How many domains are covered on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The examination covers exactly 5 distinct domains, focusing extensively on core features, artificial intelligence optimization, lead qualification, opportunity research, and powerful platform extensions across the ecosystem.
